'''Market Place''' was a flea market and bazaar near the center of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Originally it was just a sandy lot where [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] would set up their tents, but by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] it was a thriving market. Sellers here rarely bother securing trade permits or other official documentation. Two significant businesses in the area are [[Gep's Grill]] and [[Spaceport Express/Legends|Spaceport Express]].<ref name="GG7" />
